labels.rationale: Usage question: Rich already supports stripping markup via Text.from_markup(...).plain

items.body:
Rich can already do this. Parse the string with `Text.from_markup()` and read `.plain`, which returns the text with all markup and styles removed:

```python
from rich.text import Text

plain = Text.from_markup("[bold red]Hello[/] [green]world[/]").plain
# "Hello world"
```

See the [markup docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/markup.rst). Related: #2016 asks a similar question about stripping styles in a log handler. For usage questions, [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) is the right place.
